mapper.select: select ps.id, ps.match_id as matchId, ps.team_id as teamId, t.team_name as teamName, ps.player_id as playerId, p.real_name as playerName, p.player_no as playerNo, ps.roster_id as rosterId, ps.started_flag as startedFlag, ps.minutes_seconds as minutesSeconds, ps.points, ps.rebounds, ps.offensive_rebounds as offensiveRebounds, ps.defensive_rebounds as defensiveRebounds, ps.assists, ps.steals, ps.blocks, ps.turnovers, ps.fouls, ps.field_goals_made as fieldGoalsMade, ps.field_goals_attempted as fieldGoalsAttempted, ps.field_goal_pct as fieldGoalPct, ps.three_points_made as threePointsMade, ps.three_points_attempted as threePointsAttempted, ps.three_point_pct as threePointPct, ps.free_throws_made as freeThrowsMade, ps.free_throws_attempted as freeThrowsAttempted, ps.free_throw_pct as freeThrowPct, ps.plus_minus as plusMinus, ps.efficiency, ps.data_status as dataStatus, ps.confirmed_by as confirmedBy, ps.confirmed_time as confirmedTime from basket_match_player_stat ps left join basket_team t on ps.team_id = t.id and t.is_delete = 0 left join basket_player_profile p on ps.player_id = p.id and p.is_delete = 0 where ps.match_id = #{matchId} and ps.is_delete = 0 order by ps.team_id, ps.points desc
mapper.update: update basket_match_player_stat set is_delete = 1, update_time = now() where match_id = #{matchId} and is_delete = 0

update basket_match_player_stat set data_status = #{toStatus}, confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, confirmed_time = #{confirmedTime}, update_time = now() where match_id = #{matchId} and is_delete = 0 and data_status in #{s}
mapper.insert:

(#{item.matchId}, #{item.seasonId}, #{item.stageId}, #{item.teamId}, #{item.playerId}, #{item.rosterId}, #{item.startedFlag}, #{item.minutesSeconds}, #{item.points}, #{item.rebounds}, #{item.offensiveRebounds}, #{item.defensiveRebounds}, #{item.assists}, #{item.steals}, #{item.blocks}, #{item.turnovers}, #{item.fouls}, #{item.fieldGoalsMade}, #{item.fieldGoalsAttempted}, #{item.fieldGoalPct}, #{item.threePointsMade}, #{item.threePointsAttempted}, #{item.threePointPct}, #{item.freeThrowsMade}, #{item.freeThrowsAttempted}, #{item.freeThrowPct}, #{item.plusMinus}, #{item.efficiency}, #{item.doubleDouble}, #{item.tripleDouble}, #{item.dataStatus}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime}, #{item.isDelete})
